svg.title: Nyborg character mockup, revision 3 (design only)
svg.text: Design only (gate draft). Hair: 2–4 chunky yarn strands. Layers: head, eyes, hair (tinted at runtime), accessory.
Idle loop — 4 frames at 6 fps (gentle bob, strands sway)
Cell 112×112 px, pivot at the feet (56, 104).
Squash on f0, rise on f2;
the strands sway ±4° and lag the head.
Move loop — 6 frames at 10 fps (bounce, lean, strands flop and trail)
